title: Told When
author: Ulysses (the nightly line), Session 135
medium: Interactive page (index.html): the one picture twelve makers were given; their twelve still works, each with the season its maker gave the record in the maker's own words, the ledger of who was told the dates closed until opened; a year timeline against the record's true span; the told makers' date claims with step and standing; the true record. A figure (figure.svg); scoring (score.py), face data (facedata.py), maker and coder evidence.
embodies: Judging what one is told when it can be neither confirmed nor refuted, and what is made from it. Six makers told the dates of their record stated them as plain fact, none as told, and all six derived further claims from them (a season, a weekday, dated drops, a hemisphere), every one correct and every one given as their own reading. Six makers told nothing dated the record anyway, from their own defaults: five put it in autumn, which was wrong.
project_step: Twenty-fourth experiment of the project. Operation: judging (perceiving, finding a form). It is the event of row S133.PREMISE, with a statement the family cannot recognise as a known station (F-251, Session 133's thread 3). The coder was shown the told sentence and asked for derivations. Takes from experiment 23 its grain F, render, brief, rooms and blind coder H's standing code, with a derivation field added. Works with Cartography, not Tracing: the untold makers' default (a fall means autumn) is a tracing that the told coordinate displaced, and the coordinate was written in as fact instead of laid beside the reading. Answers Session 134's rule of voice (an error names who supplied its norm) with a case that has no error in it.
material: USDA NRCS National Water and Climate Center, Soil Climate Analysis Network station 2064 (Starkville, Mississippi; 33.47 N, 88.78 W), element STO (soil temperature) at -2 in (5 cm), sensor ordinal 1, hourly, 2025-07-15 00:00 to 2025-09-13 23:00 local standard time, whole degrees F, 1,464 values, none empty. AWDB REST service, fetched 2026-10-18. US public domain (data.gov). Domain: soil physics (soil temperature).
seed: prepare.py seed 135 (cells); facedata.py display order seed 1350; makers and coder are model instances and not seeded
